entries.title: A key a website shows you stays out of your crewmate's reach
entries.body: When you take over a crewmate's browser and a site shows you a new access key in a well-known format, the crewmate no longer reads it once you hand the browser back. It reads that a key was hidden, and takes no picture of that page. A key in a less common format is not covered yet.
entries.noPicture: Only what a crewmate reads changes; your own view of the page is the same.
